title: chart-test-swarm scenario
description: One customer-shaped cluster + product chart + assertions. Path fields are resolved relative to the consumer project root (the dir containing chart-test-swarm.yaml).

not.description: capability and integration are mutually exclusive — a scenario must have one or neither, never both.

config.description: Path to provider-specific config (e.g. kind --config yaml). Relative to project root.

version.description: Cilium chart version; falls back to versions.yaml cni.cilium.version, then engine default.

values.description: Project-relative path to a Cilium helm values file (ingress controller, policy modes, etc.).

kube_proxy_replacement.description: Install Cilium in full eBPF kube-proxy replacement mode.

chart.description: Path or OCI ref (oci://...) to the chart. Local paths resolve against project root.

values.description: Path to values.yaml override. Relative to project root.

set.description: helm --set key=value overrides applied on top of values.

subcharts.description: Informational: which subchart variants are exercised. Surfaces in dashboard rollup.

category.description: Library taxonomy category (e.g. networking, gateway-api, service-mesh, certificates, storage, capability, cloud-native). Drives catalog grouping and support-matrix placement.

capability.description: Chart capability/compliance test name (e.g. label-all-objects, scheme-enforced). Mutually exclusive with 'integration' at the scenario level — one or the other (or neither).

integration.description: Integration target name (e.g. cert-manager, traefik, istio). Mutually exclusive with 'capability' at the scenario level — one or the other (or neither).

tier.description: Execution tier. live: runs on local kind. authored-only: cloud-specific, off by default. capability: addon-less render+deploy + manifest introspection.

mechanisms.description: Free-vocabulary rollup labels for the dashboard. Convention: <kind>:<name>, e.g. addon:istio, subchart:postgres-internal.

generated_by.description: Provenance: who/what generated this scenario. Optional but useful for dashboard filtering of LLM-generated scenarios.

integration.description: Integration target the scenario was generated for, e.g. 'cert-manager'

kind.description: Preinstall item kind. Defaults to 'helm' for backward compatibility with pre-F1.2 scenarios that omit this field.

oneOf.title: Helm chart preinstall
oneOf.description: Install a Helm chart before the product chart. This is the default kind when 'kind' is omitted.

chart.description: Helm chart ref. Either 'repo/name' (needs prior helm repo add) or OCI ref (oci://...).

values.description: Path to values.yaml or inline object. Path is relative to project root.

repo.description: If set, runs 'helm repo add <name> <url>' before install.

oneOf.title: Raw manifest preinstall
oneOf.description: Apply a raw Kubernetes manifest via kubectl apply -f before the product chart.

path.description: Path to the manifest file (relative to project root) or a URL (https://...). Required.

namespace.description: Optional namespace override passed via kubectl --namespace.

timeout.description: Per-assert timeout (e.g. 30s, 5m). Used as the overall wait ceiling by wait_with_backoff.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts after the initial probe. 0 means a single attempt. Must be a non-negative integer.

path.description: Path to executable. Receives RELEASE, NAMESPACE, KUBECONFIG as env.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: every rendered/live object carries the configured extra labels.

labels.description: Map of key=value labels expected on ALL objects (both .metadata.labels and pod template labels).

source.description: Where to inspect: helm template output, live kubectl output, or both.

kinds.description: Kubernetes kinds to check (default: all rendered/live kinds).

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: every rendered/live object carries the configured extra annotations.

annotations.description: Map of key=value annotations expected on ALL objects (both .metadata.annotations and pod template annotations).

kinds.description: Kubernetes kinds to check (default: all rendered/live kinds).

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: no plain-HTTP port/scheme when HTTPS-only is configured; Service/container ports reflect the configured scheme.

scheme.description: Expected scheme policy. https-only: no port 80 or http scheme on Service/container/probe/Ingress. allow-http: baseline check that http/80 is present.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: rbac.create=true yields expected ServiceAccount + Role/ClusterRole + RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding; false yields none.

expect_present.description: true: RBAC objects MUST exist and be wired. false: zero RBAC-kind objects.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: pod-level and container-level securityContext knobs are rendered with configured values (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: pod-level and container-level securityContext fields MUST appear with configured values. false: no securityContext block on any workload.

podSecurityContext.description: Expected pod-level securityContext fields (e.g. runAsNonRoot, seccompProfile.type). Checked when expect_present=true.

containerSecurityContext.description: Expected container-level securityContext fields (e.g. readOnlyRootFilesystem, allowPrivilegeEscalation, capabilities). Checked when expect_present=true.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: networkPolicy.enabled=true yields a NetworkPolicy selecting the product pods; false yields none.

expect_present.description: true: at least one NetworkPolicy MUST exist selecting the workload. false: zero NetworkPolicy documents.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: resource requests/limits are set on every workload container (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: every workload container MUST carry resources.requests and resources.limits. false: no populated resources block on any container.

requests.description: Expected resources.requests fields (e.g. cpu, memory). Checked when expect_present=true.

limits.description: Expected resources.limits fields (e.g. cpu, memory). Checked when expect_present=true.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: imagePullSecrets propagate to every workload pod spec and optionally to the chart ServiceAccount (expect_present=true) or are absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: imagePullSecrets MUST appear on every workload pod spec (and ServiceAccount if one exists). false: no imagePullSecrets on any pod spec or ServiceAccount.

secret_names.description: Expected imagePullSecret name(s) (e.g. ['regcred']). Checked when expect_present=true.

check_service_account.description: Also check imagePullSecrets on the chart's ServiceAccount (if one is rendered).

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: ServiceAccount carries configured cloud-identity annotations (IRSA / Azure workload identity / GKE WI) when expect_present=true, or omits them when false.

expect_present.description: true: the rendered ServiceAccount MUST carry the configured annotations. false: the ServiceAccount MUST NOT carry cloud-identity annotation keys.

annotations.description: Expected annotation key=value pairs on the ServiceAccount. Checked when expect_present=true.

identity_keys.description: Cloud-identity annotation keys that MUST be absent when expect_present=false (e.g. eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn, azure.workload.identity/client-id, iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account).

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: scheduling knobs (nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity, topologySpreadConstraints) are rendered with configured values on ALL workloads (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: configured scheduling fields MUST appear on every workload pod spec. false: none of the checked scheduling fields may appear.

check_nodeSelector.description: Check nodeSelector field on pod specs.

check_tolerations.description: Check tolerations field on pod specs.

check_affinity.description: Check affinity field on pod specs.

check_topologySpreadConstraints.description: Check topologySpreadConstraints field on pod specs.

nodeSelector.description: Expected nodeSelector key=value pairs. Checked when expect_present=true and check_nodeSelector=true.

tolerations.description: Expected tolerations entries. Checked when expect_present=true and check_tolerations=true.

affinity.description: Expected affinity block. Checked when expect_present=true and check_affinity=true.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Expected topologySpreadConstraints entries. Checked when expect_present=true and check_topologySpreadConstraints=true.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: priorityClassName is rendered with configured value on ALL workloads (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: priorityClassName MUST appear on every workload pod spec with the configured value. false: no priorityClassName on any workload.

priority_class_name.description: Expected priorityClassName value. Checked when expect_present=true.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves NetworkPolicy/CiliumNetworkPolicy enforcement — allowed traffic succeeds AND denied traffic is blocked. SKIPs when the platform capability is absent.

allowed_label.description: Label for the allowed probe pod.

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status from the allowed probe.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves service mesh mTLS enforcement — plaintext is rejected AND in-mesh traffic succeeds over auto-upgraded mTLS. SKIPs when the platform capability is absent.

control_namespace.description: Non-mesh control namespace for plaintext probe.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves a valid TLS certificate is served — real cert, not expired, SAN matches host, CA trusted. SKIPs when the platform capability is absent.

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status from the HTTPS probe.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves an Ingress controller actually routes traffic to the product backend. SKIPs when the platform capability is absent.

controller_namespace.description: Namespace of the ingress controller (default: ingress-nginx).

controller_label.description: Label selector for controller pods (default: app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx).

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status from the ingress probe.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves a Gateway API route actually serves traffic through the data plane. SKIPs when the platform capability is absent.

controller_namespace.description: Namespace of the gateway controller (default: envoy-gateway-system).

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status from the gateway probe.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves an admission policy actually denies a violating object and admits a compliant one. SKIPs when the platform capability is absent.

violating_fixture.description: Path relative to PROJECT_DIR of a fixture that SHOULD be denied by the policy.

compliant_fixture.description: Path relative to PROJECT_DIR of a fixture that SHOULD be admitted by the policy.

policy_name.description: Name of the policy/constraint to check for readiness.

policy_namespace.description: Namespace where the admission controller pods run.

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves RBAC permissions are effectively granted via kubectl auth can-i. SKIPs when the ServiceAccount is absent.

denied.description: Verb/resource pairs that SHOULD return 'no' (boundary check).

oneOf.description: L3 behavioral assert: proves pods actually land on the targeted node via nodeName verification. SKIPs when no scheduling config or no pods.

target_label.description: Label key=value that target nodes MUST carry (e.g. 'node-role.kubernetes.io/worker=').

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: probes (readiness, liveness, startup) are rendered on workload containers (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: every workload container MUST carry the configured probe types. false: no probe blocks on any container.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: volumeMounts and matching volumes are rendered on workload containers (expect_present=true) or absent (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: every workload container MUST carry volumeMounts with matching volumes. false: no volumeMounts on any container.

mountPath.description: Expected mountPath value to verify on volumeMounts.

volume_name.description: Expected volume name referenced by the volumeMount at mountPath.

source_type.description: Expected volume source type (e.g. configMap, secret, emptyDir, hostPath) for the backing volume.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: a PodDisruptionBudget selects the release workload (expect_present=true) or no PDB exists (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: at least one PDB MUST exist whose selector matches release workload labels. false: no PDB may exist.

oneOf.description: Addon-less capability assert: an HPA targets the release workload with correct min/max replicas (expect_present=true) or no HPA exists (expect_present=false).

expect_present.description: true: at least one HPA MUST exist whose scaleTargetRef points at a release workload. false: no HPA may exist.

min_replicas.description: Expected minReplicas value. Checked when expect_present=true.

max_replicas.description: Expected maxReplicas value. Checked when expect_present=true.
